{{Quote|I have always considered myself to be a counterbalance, and in the past few years we've found ourselves on opposite sides of almost every issue, including the library he built and the credits he lavished on creating a space force for Naboo.|Senator Palpatine on King Veruna|<ref name="SW:DP" />}}
'''Veruna's tower''' was one of the many towers that made up the [[Theed Royal Palace/Legends|Royal Palace]] in [[Theed/Legends|Theed]], [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. It was built under the rule of [[Monarch of Naboo/Legends|King]] [[Ars Veruna/Legends|Veruna]] and housed a vast library, one that was even far larger than that of Theed's [[Royal Academy/Legends|Royal Academy]]. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], an abduction attempt on [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]], the [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], occurred around the bottom of Veruna's tower.

==History==
[[File:Library_tower_over_stage.png|thumb|left|150px|The library tower overlooked the Chancellor's stage]]
Veruna's tower was built during the thirteen-[[Standard year/Legends|year]] reign of [[Ars Veruna/Legends|Ars Veruna]], [[Monarch of Naboo/Legends|King]] of the [[Naboo (people)/Legends|Naboo]], to contain the vast library of the [[Theed Royal Palace/Legends|Royal Palace]] in [[Theed/Legends|Theed]], [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]].<ref name="SWCL" /> King Veruna's [[Book/Legends|book]] collection was considerable, even more so than that of the [[Royal Academy/Legends|Royal Academy]] of Theed.<ref name="FF12">{{FactFile|12|NAB 9-14|Naboo &ndash; Theed Royal Palace}}</ref> At the [[Time/Legends|time]] of its construction, the library tower was one of the contentious issues between the sovereign and [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]], Naboo's representative to the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]].<ref name="SW:DP" />

More than a [[Standard decade/Legends|decade]] after Veruna's abdication and [[Death/Legends|death]], at some point during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Palpatine had been elected [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. He was asked to deliver a speech for the [[Festival of Light/Legends|Festival of Light]], which commemorated Naboo joining the Republic eight-hundred and forty-seven years earlier. A stage was set for the him on a [[Overlook stage|terrace]] overlooked by the library tower. Fearing that [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|enemies]] of the Republic would kidnap the Chancellor, the [[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|Naboo Royal Guards]] placed armed sentry points at all entrances of the palace, including one in King Veruna's library tower.<ref name="Crisis">{{TCW|Crisis on Naboo}}</ref>

==Layout==
[[File:TheedLibrary.jpg|thumb|370px|Theed Palace royal library, built by King Veruna.]]
King Veruna's tower, like the other spires of the Royal Palace was made of [[Sandstone/Legends|sandstone]]-like blocks. A drum-shaped tower, it was topped with a cupola covered in green tile. Located at the back of the Palace, on cliff side, the library tower was connected to the palace's rear watchtower by a skywalk.<ref name="SWCL" /> The tower's upper level featured arched, non-glazed [[Window/Legends|windows]].<ref name="TPM">{{Film|I}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Veruna's library tower first appeared, along with the rest of the Theed Palace, in the [[May]] [[1999]] movie [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']], the first installement of the ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[prequel trilogy]].<ref name="TPM" /> It was present on the conceptual drawings for the films as early as [[April]] [[1998]], when the movie underwent its second shooting phase.<ref name="TPMIG">[[Star Wars: Episode I Insider's Guide|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''Insider's Guide'']]</ref>
